title: The readiness ledger is measured and published, and the gate says which kind of failure it found

sha_binding.verified_source_note: Bound to the merge commit on main. PR #1326 was squash-merged, so the implementation head 3839ff43755e60eaebd2661880415c8784c83f7a is not an ancestor of main; 328ac4b3d05ec4905520c4aedd4d5867e02b3495 is the commit that carries this tree. The measurements below were produced on that exact tree and were not re-run afterwards against a different one.

verify_static.note: pnpm verify cannot complete on a workstation without staging credentials — inherited from UTV2-1630, which pinned every writable DB stage to the staging project. verify:static is the sanctioned local equivalent (verify:local). The authoritative full run is the required `verify` context in CI.

workflow_credential_scanner.note: readiness-refresh.yml holds a production READ credential and is schedule + workflow_dispatch only, so it creates no pull-request-reachable exposure. The pull-request gate job holds no credential at all.

runtime_proof.mechanism: live read-only measurement of canonical production
runtime_proof.read_only_basis: The generator's only database surface is the ReadOnlyDb wrapper in scripts/ops/readiness-refresh.ts, which exposes select reads only. There is no insert/update/upsert/delete/rpc path in the file, and readiness-refresh.test.ts scans the source to keep it that way.

persistence_assertion.note: Exercised in both directions. A one-directional check would be worthless here: the mode exists to catch a run that produced nothing, so it has to be shown failing on that input.

positive_case.input: the newly measured ledger, against the copy from origin/main
positive_case.output: [readiness-persistence] OK — ledger rewritten with 9 dimensions, all observed within this run (generated_at 2026-07-30T23:40:39.763Z)

negative_case.input: the ledger compared against a byte-identical copy of itself
negative_case.output: NOT_REWRITTEN: the ledger is byte-identical to the previous version — the generator did not execute, or its output was not published
negative_case.significance: This is the exact shape of the 29 consecutive green refresh runs that left the ledger untouched for 14.8 days. It now fails.

gate_classification_proof.note: Same gate, same repository, two inputs — the observer failure and the product condition come back separated and correctly named.

origin_main_ledger.significance: The file says RED, but the gate refuses to report it as READINESS_RED. A stale RED is not evidence of a current RED.

defect_being_closed.prior_behaviour: Checked the ledger file's age and opened a GitHub issue. It never invoked a generator, because none existed.
defect_being_closed.impact: The pull-request gate failed every lane on a RED verdict nobody could confirm was still true, and a real regression was indistinguishable from a forgotten artifact. UTV2-1630's proof bundle records the gate as 'red and pre-existing … left red deliberately' — the correct call under the old design, and the signal loss this lane removes.

self_referential_hazard.statement: This branch changes the Readiness Regression Gate itself, so its status on this pull request is stated explicitly rather than left ambiguous.
self_referential_hazard.not_broken_because: The gate classifies as READINESS_RED with observer_failure=false on a ledger 0h old. All four blocking dimensions are live reads taken today against canonical production.
self_referential_hazard.deliberately_not_made_green: Making it green would require writing a readiness score this lane did not measure, which is exactly the defect this lane exists to remove. The four blockers are production runtime state this diff does not touch.
follow_up_owners: deploy_sha_alignment — main is 357 commits ahead of the last successful deploy (2026-06-30)
worker_outbox_health — worker heartbeat 14.8 days old, 32 rows processing past the 5m window
dead_letter_count — 1 true delivery failure among 1947 governance holds

direct_main_push_guard.change: Admitted the scheduled ledger commit as a known automation identity.
direct_main_push_guard.rationale: The ledger has to land on main to be the pull-request gate's input, and it is machine-generated every 6h. Routing it through a pull request would mean either a bot-authored PR every 6h or an artifact that goes stale again. The admission is one exact message pattern and one file, not a widening of the guard.

known_limitations: constitution_convergence and db_tripwires are reported unknown, so observability is degraded even when every readable dimension is fine. Convergence has no generator in this repository; db_tripwires is unreadable because db-health-tripwire.yml is itself failing. Both are recorded as unproven rather than assumed — correct, but it means a fully GREEN verdict is unreachable until a convergence generator exists and the tripwire observer is repaired.

The scheduled refresher needs SYNC_BOT_TOKEN to push through branch protection. Without it the push step fails — the intended outcome, since a refresh that cannot publish is not a refresh — but it surfaces as an observer-failure issue rather than as a configuration message.

The persistence assertion proves the ledger is new and was published. It does not prove the numbers inside it are true; that rests on the generator's reads being against the canonical production ref, which is asserted in code and cannot fall back to another target.

pnpm verify cannot complete on a workstation without staging credentials (inherited from UTV2-1630). Local coverage is verify:static; the authoritative full run is the required `verify` context in CI.
Live Schema Parity is red and pre-existing: migration-ledger drift tracked under UTV2-1274. This lane touches no migration and the check is not a required context.
explicitly_not: no production database mutation — every read goes through the select-only ReadOnlyDb wrapper
no production credential in any pull_request-triggered workflow job; the refresher is schedule + workflow_dispatch only
no direct-main push, no admin merge
no readiness score asserted without measuring it
